page.overview:
Who is Mardia?

Mardia is a muscular female fighter whose face is concealed by her red hair. She wears a long one-piece red dress, red arm guards, and red high heeled boots.

Mardia attacks by projecting gobs of green slime that can melt anything they touch. In the SNES port, she throws bombs instead.
